data.one_liner: Synchronous HTTP client for Dart using RawSynchronousSockets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a synchronous HTTP client implementation using RawSynchronousSockets to allow for synchronous HTTP requests. It blocks the calling thread to wait for a response from the server.
use_when: You need to connect to HTTP servers hosted on localhost
You have very specialized use cases requiring synchronous requests
avoid_when: You cannot afford to block the calling thread while waiting for a server response
weaknesses: Blocks the calling thread and cannot process other events while waiting
Not suitable for applications requiring high performance

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Recommended for general HTTP usage and asynchronous I/O performance.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Powerful HTTP client supporting interceptors, global configuration, and asynchronous requests.
